axes.base: warm paper under 30-degree stripes; navy blueprint with a 60 px grid
axes.line: hand-inked lib.inkPath, pressure ±25%, 12 fps boil; double lavender outlines on blueprint
axes.tone: hatching and stipple on paper, never gradients; glow halos only on blueprint
axes.planB: the blueprint plate explains the inside of what the paper plate shows
axes.motion: characters on twos, camera and overlays at 24 fps, snappy pops on the beat
axes.carrier: paper grain on A, fine noise on B (core post)
axes.accent: magenta for moments of change, at most 12 frames
axes.match: silhouette match cuts between paper and blueprint on shared geometry
axes.overlays: rings, trajectories, rulers and brackets in four overlay colours
